featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently booked a tour with J. M. Tours & Travels in Mumbai and I was thoroughly impressed. From start to finish, the experience was seamless, enjoyable, and personalized.

What stood out:

The itinerary was thoughtfully put together—whether it was the Mumbai City Tour, Elephanta Island, or the lesser-known gems, everything had a good balance between iconic sights and authentic local culture.

The vehicles were comfortable and clean. Drivers were punctual, professional, and made us feel safe throughout.

The team listened to what we wanted, and tailored parts of the trip accordingly. They struck a nice balance between scheduled activity and flexibility.

Accommodation & transfers (where arranged by them) were smooth, well-located and comfortable.

The guides were knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate—it really enhanced the experience, giving insights you don’t get from just reading guidebooks.

Communication was good; when we had queries, they responded in a timely manner, and the booking process was clear.

Minor suggestions:

A little more clarity in pricing breakdowns (what’s included / what’s extra) would help avoid surprises.

In one of the day tours, time at some spots felt a bit rushed; a slightly more relaxed schedule there would make it even better.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I booked a Force Urbania from MS CAR for an airport pickup and a three-day business trip in Mumbai. Since our guests were visiting from outside India, we wanted a transportation service that was professional, punctual and comfortable. MS CAR exceeded our expectations on every front.

The vehicle was in outstanding condition, both inside and outside. The interiors were spotless, the seats were extremely comfortable and the air conditioning worked perfectly throughout the trip. Our guests immediately noticed the quality of the vehicle and appreciated the comfortable travel experience.

The driver was one of the most professional chauffeurs I have come across. He arrived before time, was well-groomed, polite and maintained a professional attitude throughout the journey. He was familiar with all routes and ensured that our guests reached every destination on schedule.

The booking team also deserves appreciation for their excellent coordination. They remained available whenever required and ensured that every detail was handled smoothly. It is clear that customer satisfaction is a priority for them.

In an industry where reliability can sometimes be a challenge, MS CAR stands out because of its commitment to quality service, punctuality and professionalism. I would highly recommend them for corporate travel, airport transfers, weddings, family trips and luxury group transportation. Looking forward to booking with them again in the future.
